version.changelog: Restore the v0.1.4 single-stage transcript-to-WorkoutSummary workflow.

llm.summary: The skill does what it claims, but users should understand that audio may be sent to a chosen transcription provider and a public exercise dataset may be downloaded and cached.

dimensions.detail: Optional cloud transcription via configured provider credentials is disclosed, and the exercise matcher can fetch a GitHub-hosted dataset; both are proportionate to the purpose but have privacy and supply-chain implications.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a skill file, one reference document, and two small Python helpers; no install-time commands, package installation, privilege changes, or auto-start behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to workout summarization, include guardrails against inventing medical details, and say not to create hosted storage, indexes, databases, or remote workout records unless explicitly requested.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The matcher caches the downloaded dataset under the user's home cache directory, while generated transcripts or summaries are documented as saved only when requested; no background persistence or privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to summarize strength-training recordings or transcripts, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: transcription, duration calculation, exercise-name matching, and concise summary output.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the selected transcription backend handling workout audio when local Whisper is unavailable or not chosen. For maximum privacy, provide an existing transcript or use local Whisper, and consider supplying a local exercises.json dataset instead of relying on the automatic GitHub download/cache.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The cloud transcription and dataset matching behavior is related to the workout-summary purpose and is disclosed in the skill/reference text, so this is a user-awareness privacy note rather than evidence of deceptive or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: The helper does automatically download and cache the exercise dataset if no local dataset or cache is present, but the reference documentation describes this behavior and no workout transcript or audio content is sent as part of that fetch.
[SDI-2] expected: The hardcoded GitHub dataset URL is real and unpinned, creating a modest integrity dependency, but it supports the documented exercise-name standardization function and is not hidden exfiltration or unrelated network access.
